title: THS-seq
scope: Sos 2016 THS-seq implementation; retain specified transposition/readout differences. The extraction follows the standalone Illumina THS-seq schematic and the corresponding THS-seq middle row of the poster. It starts at chromatin accessible to transposition and ends at the barcoded Illumina DNA library. Primary text resolves IVT output as RNA and dsDNA synthesis as cDNA synthesis, specifies Tn5059 initial chromatin tagging versus EzTn5 cDNA tagging, and supplies the single-end/sample-index readout interpretation. Neighboring ATAC-seq and CATCH-IT rows, proposed adaptations, pooling, sequencing execution and data analysis are outside the depicted route.

operations.label: Insert custom transposons into accessible chromatin
operations.description: Tn5059 transposomes act on cellular chromatin, inserting custom DNA tags and creating tagged genomic DNA ends in accessible regions.
operations.mechanism: Custom Tn5059 transposome insertion; the Sos 2016 optimized initial tagmentation buffer contains 16% DMF. The custom dimer/cargo design yields usable ends in either transposon orientation.
operations.information_effect: Genomic DNA next to initial insertion sites becomes linked to a T7-driven amplification interface. Accessibility is sampled through insertion; this does not establish absolute exclusion of background insertion.

operations.label: Fill DNA ends and amplify by T7 in vitro transcription
operations.description: Fill gaps in the recovered tagged DNA, then use its introduced T7 promoter to make RNA amplification products for the next block.
operations.mechanism: DNA gap fill-in precedes T7 RNA polymerase transcription. Linear amplification of insertion-end sequences is independent of the distance between neighboring initial insertion sites; the DNA template is not itself converted into RNA.
operations.information_effect: RNA copies carry sequence information from accessible-site DNA ends, rather than measuring endogenous cellular RNA abundance. End amplification avoids requiring a PCR-amplifiable genomic interval between adjacent initial insertions.

method_scopes.rationale: All five action blocks belong to the named THS-seq row and standalone schematic. Open DNA is a starting-material caption, not a DNA-opening operation; the Tn5/Read primer/T7 promoter icon supplies the transposome input, not a separate action. Poster neighbors are context, not grouped targets. The primary paper describes this THS-seq architecture and resolves the two distinct transposition substrates and enzymes. Its custom RNA-seq is an internal library-conversion component, not an additional target method. Reported single-end sequencing explains the library readout without adding an unshown data branch.
